title: Localize capability permission settings
context: The capability permission panel in Settings is written in Vietnamese but lacks localization catalog entries, so the English app language still shows Vietnamese-only labels and guidance.
goal: Add English and Vietnamese localization entries for the Agent capability permission panel without changing permission semantics.
forbidden_changes: Do not change permission defaults or runtime enforcement.
Do not alter credential storage or destructive-action approval behavior.
Do not change any existing Vietnamese display wording.
acceptance_criteria: The panel title, explanatory text, four toggles and destructive-action warning have entries in both catalogs.
English values are natural English; Vietnamese values preserve the current wording.
No duplicate localization keys are introduced.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Static duplicate-key scan for both localization catalogs
recovery: Revert the single task commit if localization or the Apple build regresses.
